plan.notes: Transcribed from the official SCC 'Real Estate Broker Certificate' program map, Catalog 2026-27, published May 12, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7648/PublishedPdf). Certificate of Achievement (grade of C or better in each major course). Official Total Units: 24-26; this seed models the first-listed/recommended path at the low end = 12+12 = 24 units (RE 360 at 3 units; both Major Elective slots at 3 units). Semester sums verified against the map's 12-13 / 12-13 headers. Choice slots: (1) ME RE 360 / ACCT 301 — Real Estate Economics (3-4, modeled at 3); (2) ME Major Elective (3 units) and (3) ME Major Elective (3-4, modeled at 3) — a minimum of 6 units from BUS 340, RE 350, RE 497 (select 2 courses). If both RE 360 and ACCT 301 are successfully completed, only 3 units from the Major Elective group are required. Counselor note: real estate courses may be adjusted per the class schedule each semester. tccns mirrors SCC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS).
